filters.smile: five OTM distinct strikes, two strictly each side; local quadratic; bid/ask-IV sensitivity

inference_caveats: Calendar-sampled first-of-month days, not random or continuous sessions.
Bootstrap treats sampled days as independent and has few clusters; it is a diagnostic, not a certification.
Power calculation is a normal-planning approximation using validation dispersion, not guaranteed power or an economic significance threshold.
Learning curve uses trailing windows with a fixed end date; sample size and included historical regimes still change together.
Features and hedge conversion reflect an illustrative SM benchmark, not a user-approved final specification.
